text:
Bring Stories to Life Through Creative Content 
 We are seeking a Multimedia Production Specialist who is passionate about visual storytelling and skilled at turning ideas into powerful content. From video and motion graphics to digital campaigns and branded materials, you will play a key role in shaping how our brand shows up and connects with audiences.
 If you are creative, tech-savvy, and excited to produce content that makes an impact, we would love to hear from you.
 Candidates must be based in India and may be located anywhere within the country. 
 Key Responsibilities

• Create, edit, and produce multimedia content, including videos, motion graphics, presentations, and digital assets

• Design visually compelling materials for marketing campaigns, social media, websites, events, and internal communications

• Collaborate with marketing, content, and leadership teams to translate ideas into engaging visual content

• Manage projects from concept through final delivery while meeting deadlines and quality standards

• Support video production tasks, including filming, editing, sound syncing, and post-production

• Maintain brand consistency across all creative materials and communication channels

• Optimize multimedia content for various platforms, including web, mobile, and social media

• Organize and manage digital assets, files, and production libraries

• Stay current on design trends, multimedia tools, and emerging content formats

 Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Multimedia, Graphic Design, Video Production, Communications, Marketing, or a related field preferred

• 4+ years of experience in multimedia production, graphic design, video editing, or related creative work

• Proficiency in tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects, and InDesign

• Experience creating content for digital marketing and social media platforms

• Strong portfolio showcasing multimedia, video, and design work

• Excellent visual storytelling, design, and editing skills

• Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple deadlines

• Strong communication and collaboration skills

• Attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work

 Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with photography, videography, or animation

• Familiarity with CMS platforms, email marketing assets, and web content production

• Understanding of branding, content strategy, and audience engagement

• Experience working in a fast-paced agency, in-house marketing, or creative environment

 Why Join Us?

• Opportunity to work on a variety of creative projects

• Collaborative and innovative team environment

• Chance to make a direct impact on brand growth and audience engagement

• Room for creativity, ownership, and professional development
